cards.title: Strategic Opportunity & Market Impact
cards.botDialogue: Welcome! I am Aayam. Let's look at the strategic business opportunity for SAP BTP Vibe Coding & Enterprise AI Foundation. Here is how we transform operational velocity.
bullets: Fragmented Developer Tooling: Traditional SAP setups require 3-5 days across disparate CLIs, Node runtimes, and MTA tools with constant environment drift and permission mismatches.
Opaque AI Integration & Cloud Governance: Connecting modern LLMs (Anthropic Claude 3.7 / 4.5) to SAP enterprise workflows often breaches Clean Core standards or incurs uncontrolled cloud egress.
Complex Cloud Foundry & AI Core Provisioning: Manually provisioning Cloud Foundry spaces, role collections, extended AI Core plans, and service keys is error-prone and delays modernization.

cards.title: Enterprise Process Bottlenecks
cards.botDialogue: Examining the core friction points in current operations. Notice the process bottlenecks that create revenue leakage.
bullets: Disconnected data silos across regional plants and commercial entities.
High variance between physical operations and digital ledger postings.
Heavy developer dependency on proprietary legacy custom code.
